$schema.description: Code quality analysis report in JSON format

fields.projectPath: Absolute path to the analyzed project
fields.overallScore: Overall quality score (0-100, higher is better)

summary.totalFiles: Total number of files discovered in the project
summary.skippedFiles: Number of files skipped (too large, unsupported, etc.)

aggregatedMetrics.description: Aggregated metrics across all analyzed files
aggregatedMetrics.name: Metric name (e.g., cyclomatic_complexity, cognitive_complexity)
aggregatedMetrics.category: Metric category (complexity, size, duplication, structure, error, documentation, naming)

files.description: Detailed analysis results for each file
files.path: Relative path to the file from project root
files.score: Overall quality score for this file (0-100)

metrics.name: Metric name
metrics.value: Raw metric value (e.g., complexity count, line count)

parseResult.totalLines: Total lines including blank and comment lines

metricCategories.size: Size metrics (function length, file length, parameter count)

severityLevels.info: No issues detected, code quality is good
severityLevels.warning: Minor issues that should be addressed
severityLevels.critical: Critical issues that must be fixed
